title: Reassess current reliance without rewriting historical meaning
statement: The Review and verification Module shall identify affected, reusable and uncertain support after changes to a current claim, obtain proportionate accountable reassessment, and preserve unresolved and historical meaning during selective retention.

what.problem: Assurance preparation and retention can conflate planned methods, actual observations, semantic judgment and current reliance.
what.desired_outcome: Reassess current reliance without rewriting historical meaning.

why.rationale: SR-029 needs accountable assurance content and failure semantics in MOD-007.

conditions: An assessor prepares or reassesses assurance content for a declared engineering claim.

contexts: MOD-007 contribution to MOD-017 IF-014; guided recording through MOD-012 and existing IF-004/003.

how.approach: Apply assurance-content.md to exact supplied bases, preserve gaps and actual actor decisions, then confirm selected retention separately.

how_much.scope: All parent SR-029 criteria within the declared finite claim; operational persistence and execution authority retain their existing owners.

acceptance_criteria: Compare changed subjects, criteria, conditions, evidence and dependencies with the recorded basis; identify affected verification requiring repetition and expose unknown impact.

Retain only explicitly justified unaffected support; material effects require reassessment, while demonstrated immaterial edits or equivalent evidence retries may use an attributable scoped applicability disposition.
Keep repeated checks that are merely planned distinct from applicable new observations; retain affected claims as unestablished until evidence and an accountable conclusion justify them.
Bind replacement judgments to their new assessed basis, assessor, reasoning and limits; preserve unresolved obligations and prior conclusions still relied upon before compacting superseded detail.
Keep completed Change accounts historical; record later regressions as linked work and original-account mistakes as explicit annotations without silently rewriting completion.
constraints: Target Design; no implemented automation, executed verification or requirement satisfaction is asserted.

sources.basis: Derive assessor-assisted assurance preparation, explicit retention cooperation and scoped reliance through MOD-007 and IF-014. Preserve actual judgment, command and persistence ownership; target Design only.
